description: Pre-selected Sentinel-2 L2A Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) band URLs over Denver for Lab 07 (band math: NDVI, NDWI, NDBI). These point to the public sentinel-cogs S3 bucket (no credentials required with --no-sign-request). If a specific scene is unavailable, use geo-stac to search for a current low-cloud scene over the Denver AOI and substitute the URLs.

scenes.label: denver_summer_2024
scenes.note: Summer scene — expect high NDVI in parks and irrigated areas.

scenes.label: denver_winter_2024
scenes.note: Winter scene — lower NDVI, useful for the seasonal time-series exercise. Substitute a real low-cloud January scene ID from geo-stac if this one is cloudy.

windowed_read_example.note: Denver's City Park — used in the windowed-read exercise.
